name: Zachariah
source:
Casino owner in the Forbidden Zone, and leader of the organization Serpent.

[spoiler]He is Leesha's past lover, and Sergi's father. He was banned from the Regular Zone after Leesha gave birth to Sergi.[/spoiler]
